pages.text: Twolegs build stone nests and keep kittypets who never learn to hunt. Their monsters roar along the Thunderpath, the hard black path that smells of smoke.
pages.title: Twolegs

pages.text: Cross a Thunderpath only when it is quiet, and cross it fast. Many good cats were lost on that stinking stone. $(br2)Twoleg nests near the territories can hide useful things, but do not linger.
